definition_format_notes: Page/sector sequential counter. Resets per sector/page in older reports; not a persistent project key.
Text string describing the project. In 2001-2010 often combined with agency in parentheses. In 2011-2024 appended with [OCMS Code]. In 2025-2026 isolated into standalone project_name.
Alphanumeric code [e.g. N16000282, 220100330]. Introduced around 2010-2011 to uniquely track projects in Web-OCMS. Became legacy_ocms_code in PAIMANA.
6-digit unique integer assigned by new PAIMANA database (e.g. 100123). Replaced OCMS code as primary key.
Sector classification (e.g., POWER, RAILWAYS, ROAD TRANSPORT, PETROLEUM). Consistent throughout, though sector groupings occasionally merged/split.

consistently_available: Yes (Implicit in 2001-2010 via sector/agency; Explicit in 2011-2026)
definition_format_notes: Reporting Central Ministry. Explicit column in PAIMANA; inferred from Sector/PSU header in early OCMS.
PSU/Agency executing project (e.g., NTPC, NHAI, IOCL). Often embedded in project name parentheses in 2001-2014; separate field/bracket in 2015-2026.

consistently_available: Partial (Embedded in title 2001-2013; dedicated section/column in 2014-2026)
definition_format_notes: Location/State. In 2001-2009, multi-state projects often listed under regional blocks. Dedicated State column/table formalized in later OCMS & PAIMANA.
Date of government sanction/approval (MM/YYYY). Consistent concept across all eras.
Original target completion date (MM/YYYY). Highly consistent.
Latest projected completion date (MM/YYYY). In 2001-2008 labeled Anticipated DOC; in 2014-2025 split into Revised and Anticipated.

consistently_available: Only in Completed Projects Tables (Table 2 / Table 3)
definition_format_notes: Reported only when a project completes and moves to Table 3 (Completed Projects). Never present for ongoing projects.
Initial sanctioned cost in Rs. Crore. Threshold for inclusion was Rs. 20 Cr / Rs. 100 Cr in 2001-2010, then standardized to Rs. 150 Cr and above.
Cabinet/Ministry approved revised budget. In 2001-2010 often combined into Anticipated Cost column.
Latest projected total project cost in Rs. Crore.
Total funds spent till the reporting month in Rs. Crore.
Self-reported % physical completion (0-100%). Absent in early 2000s summary tables; became standard column in 2014+ OCMS.

consistently_available: No (Only available in detailed Annexure/Project sheets, not master tables)
definition_format_notes: Granular contract milestones. Present only in full OCMS monograph pages (800-page reports), omitted from summary project listings.
Explicitly printed as column in some reports; deterministically computable as Anticipated DOC - Original DOC.
Explicitly printed or computable as (Anticipated Cost - Original Cost) / Original Cost * 100.
Administrative classification based on whether Anticipated DOC exceeds Original DOC.
